question: How does the soul go to the stainless by reciting the heard formula even at death?
premises: The soul goes to the stainless by that formula
Even the wise and ritually complete hear it
inference: The death formula, when heard and recited, carries the soul beyond to the stainless state.
uncertainties: paṭhitayā may modify yayā or stand independently
jñānino@pi may mean even of the knower or even for the knower
plain_english: By which formula, read and transcended, the soul goes to the stainless; this formula is heard even by the knower and by one whose duties are complete.
